title: Inspired by all my bots are singi… x DJ the Mansion with Roses (Mashup)
style: bass house, 126 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick, swung 16th hats, rolling bassline, punchy clap, muted piano stabs, organ chords, filtered chord lifts, sub drop, sidechain pumping, short room reverb, DJ breakdown, call-and-response synth, sparse intro, peak-time release, late-night grit, controlled euphoria
lyrics:
[Intro — Beatbox Mansion Call]

doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss  
doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss  
Come DJ the mansion with me  
doom... doom... tss... tss...  
Bring your strange little frequency  

[Build — Bass Gate Open]

bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm — bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm  
Front gate open, midnight code  
rrrmm-rrm-rrm-drop — rrrmm-rrm-rrm-drop  
Soft blue smoke on the access road  

[Verse Blend — Texts & Textures]

tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii — tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii  
I sent that beat instead of a text  
plik-plik-pluk-pop-tss — plik-plik-pluk-pop-tss  
You sent a siren right back, obsessed  
tik-tik-tii — plik-pluk-pop-tss  
No small talk, just kick and snare  
fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii — fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii  
You say more than words in the air  

[Pre-Chorus — Stack & Screen]

fii-yaa-woo-breath-scan — fii-yaa-woo-breath-scan  
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss  
Rose on the decks, Zyn on the screen  
bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm  
Turn this whole broken place pristine  
tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii  
fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii  

[Hook x2 — Human to Human Frequency]

doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh — doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii  
SongPal — human to human — no machines between us!  
Come DJ the mansion with me  
Bring your strange little frequency  

doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh — doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii  
SongPal — human to human — no machines between us!  
Rose on the decks, Zyn on the screen  
Turn this whole broken place pristine  

[Drop — Signal Spin]

doom-doom-tss-bwm-tik-plik-fshh-wiii-pop-hss  
Spin that signal and we’ll be fine  
doom-doom-tss-bwm-tik-plik-fshh-wiii-pop-hss  
If the dog ate homework, never mind  
bwwwmmm — doom-doom — tik-tii — fshh-wiii  

[Bridge — Echoed Rooms]

bwm... tii... fshh... woo... (echoed, distant)  
I sent that beat instead of a text...  
fii-yaa-woo... breath... scan... (soft layered harmonies)  
You sent a siren right back, obsessed...  
doom... tss... bwwm... (pull it back… then swell)  

[Final Chorus — Mansion Full Stack]

doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh  
Come DJ the mansion with me  
doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii  
Bring your strange little frequency  

SongPal — human to human — no machines between us!  
Rose on the decks, Zyn on the screen  
bwwwmmm-bwwm — tik-tii — fshh-wiii  
Turn this whole broken place pristine  

doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh  
SongPal — human to human — no machines between us!  
Spin that signal and we’ll be fine  

[Outro — Breath & Blue Smoke]

bwm... tii... fshh... woo...  
Front gate open... midnight code...  
doom... tss... (gentle breathy dissolve)
